description_en: Configures a stack policy for a stack
description_zh: 为指定资源栈配置资源策略
kebab_example: aliyun ros set-stack-policy --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stack-policy-body Statement_:_Effect_:_Allow_,_Action_:_Update:0_,_Principal_:_0_,_Resource_:_0 --stack-policy-url oss://ros/stack-policy/demo --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetStackPolicy

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The structure that contains the stack policy body. The stack policy body must be 1 to 16,384 bytes in length.

You can specify one of the StackPolicyBody and StackPolicyURL parameters, but you cannot specify both of them.
parameters.description_zh:
包含资源栈策略主体的结构，长度为1~16,384个字节。

您可以指定StackPolicyBody或StackPolicyURL参数，但不能同时指定两者。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: stack_policy_body

parameters.description_en:
The URL for the file that contains the stack policy. The URL must point to a template located in an HTTP or HTTPS web server or an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket. Examples: oss\://ros/template/demo and oss\://ros/template/demo?RegionId=cn-hangzhou. The template can be up to 16,384 bytes in length, and the URL can be up to 1,350 bytes in length.

> If the region of the OSS bucket is not specified, the RegionId value is used.

You can specify one of the StackPolicyBody and StackPolicyURL parameters, but you cannot specify both of them.
parameters.description_zh:
包含资源栈策略主体的文件的位置。URL必须指向位于Web服务器（HTTP或HTTPS）或阿里云OSS存储桶（例如：oss://ros/template/demo、oss://ros/template/demo?RegionId=cn-hangzhou）中的模板，模板最大为16,384个字节。   

> 如果OSS地域未指定，默认与接口参数RegionId相同。  
  
您可以指定StackPolicyBody或StackPolicyURL参数，但不能同时指定两者。

URL最大长度为1350字节。
